rations.Name: Resource-based rests (Ration Pool)
rations.Hint: Optional rule (Ch7): the party spends rations from a shared pool to rest on missions.

stamina.Name: Stamina pool
stamina.Hint: Optional rule: one pool equal to proficiency bonus pays for all limited-use feat abilities.

ampLimit.Name: Amp limit
ampLimit.Hint: Optional rule (Ch8): Rule of 3's (max 3 Amps) or Singleton (one per Amp type).

freeOutOfCombatUpkeep.Name: No upkeep out of combat
freeOutOfCombatUpkeep.Hint: Optional (Ch9): outside combat, charge only the initial cost of concentration jutsu.

willOfFireVariants.Name: Will of Fire variants
willOfFireVariants.Hint: Kage Guide variants (Earth, Wind, Lightning, Water, Revenge).

hijutsuFlexibilityPick.Name: Hijutsu Flexibility: player's pick
hijutsuFlexibilityPick.Hint: Hijutsu use the higher of the clan's two abilities. When on, a player can pick one on their clan item instead.
